Tests slot delta parser cases for entries, errors, duplicates, and entry limits.

# Purpose
This file is a test program for `fd_slot_delta_parser`. It builds mock slot-delta input records, feeds them into the parser, and checks that the parser returns the expected `fd_sstxncache_entry_t` values and error codes. The test cases cover one-entry input, non-root slot rejection, several transaction and instruction error forms, and multiple-entry input with different slot and status layouts.

The file also checks parser limits and validation rules. It verifies duplicate slot detection, empty entry sets, and the maximum entry count. The [`main`](<#main>) function creates a workspace, allocates parser memory, initializes the parser, runs all test functions, and then releases the parser and workspace resources.
